Check that the account looks good.') that reduce readability and actionability compared to the source. Candidate B preserves the logical flow as a single coherent instruction, integrates the authctl command naturally, and explicitly notes the absence of expected results without inventing one. Both correctly identify the ambiguities around 'looks good', but B's ambiguity section is more complete, naming both the unspecified resource/scope and the missing acceptance criteria.
